lists.name: Numbered list (continuation)
items: Give science and all knowledge a [new & revolutionary "matrix form"].

Automation of [thinking, imagination, thoughts, intelligence], learning, experimentation, intuition, deduction, conversation, judgment, criticism & correction, behavior, invention & innovation, mental evolution, quantification & probabilities, problem solving, questioning & answering, planning, knowledge organization & evolution, perception of change, inconsistency & contradiction, analysis, metaphorical reasoning, differentiation, statement (semantic), embellishment & simplification, story-telling, mental or conceptual reorganization or transformation, generalization, induction, homogenesis, & theorization, feeling (emotion, intelligence & life?), teaching, text synthesis, language evolution, prediction, perception of naughts (existent, nonexistent, or neglected things), perception (incl. pattern recognition & image processing), generation of [alternative scenarios & gedankenexperiments], guidance & programming, research, and other mental [processes & phenomena].
Discovery of all [actual & possible] types of order, and creation of a (universal) science of order.
Discovery, classification, extrapolation, generalization, & synthesis of all [trends & themes in science, technology, & Nature].
Identification of all of Nature's [fundamental, universal, & orthogonal] combinatorial dimensions.

notes: The photographed sheet is a continuation numbered 15–24. Items 17, 18, and 20 and portions of other entries are too faint or densely overwritten to transcribe reliably and were omitted.
